blocks.source: Vol IV, Safety Enforcement, § Admission, Cyclic Checking, and Monitor Independence
blocks.md: A planned waypoint can clear a warehouse rack upright in the planner's geometric check while the physical manipulator overshoots into the steel during execution, and an instantaneous motor torque well within electrical limits can accelerate the arm past the point where its remaining stopping reservation can arrest motion. Relying on trajectory admission alone misses in-flight tracking overshoot and saturation, whereas checking only single-step torque commands without a verified stopping continuation lets the arm enter an inevitable collision state before the local filter reacts.

questions.q: The section **Admission, Cyclic Checking, and Monitor Independence** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A least-change projection passes a safe proposal untouched and projects a violating one onto the barrier boundary, keeping learned competence, while a structurally invalid proposal is vetoed rather than corrected.
The pedestrian intrusion distance v_h(tau + T_stop) sets how much clearance a walking person consumes during the stop, which bounds the walking-person speed ceiling.
When contact is the task the kinetic barrier admits only zero speed, so an energy-tank passivity barrier and a separately qualified force channel replace clearance as the margin.

The enforcement record joins a signed enforcement contract (tracking bound, barrier coefficients, deadlines, effort-error bounds, routing) to a per-tick admitted command with its margin, detector, and rung.
